releases.notes: Add JPEG XL support, Minecraft 1.21.10, and NeoForge support for 26.3. JPEG XL requires cjxl from libjxl. Without it, screenshots fall back to PNG. Now available on Fabric and NeoForge for 1.21.1, 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.2, and 26.3.
